profile_text.body:
The material provided is inconsistent and too thin to support a company profile. The record is filed under DXC Technology Co, an Ashburn, Virginia public company trading as DXC with CIK 0001688568, but the website text harvested for it belongs to Dexus, an Australian real asset and funds management business (ASX: DXS) describing Australasian infrastructure and real estate funds, a multi-billion dollar portfolio, and four decades of investment and development experience. The site text also mentions Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching more than 180 metres and a Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. None of this describes DXC Technology, and no products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are recorded for the company.

Because the harvested site content does not match the company named in the record, no reliable description of what DXC Technology is or does can be written from this data. The only held facts specific to the company are its Virginia location, its public-company status, its DXC ticker, and its CIK.
